title: Tresor: the last night in the vault
event: The Wertheim site has been sold and the vault has to be empty by the end of the month. Sixteen years of steel doors, safe-deposit grilles and a floor nobody ever managed to clean end on a Saturday with the original 1991 residents playing until the power is cut. The building will be demolished; the door frames are being taken out and kept.
when: Saturday 16 April 2005, 23:00 until the power goes off
function: A club night, and the last one. Handbill, printed one colour both sides, five thousand up, given out at the door of every other club in the city for three weeks beforehand.
stakes: It is a closing, not an anniversary, and the poster has to say the difference. Nostalgia would be the wrong register: nobody is celebrating, the room is being taken away.

hard_constraints.why: One night, no second chance, no run of dates. The date is the whole logistics of the object.
The street is the specific fact that stops this being a generic industrial club flyer. It is also the address that is about to stop existing.

notes: There is no bill fixed by the commission; whoever designs it may name residents or may name nobody. The room is the headliner.
